kimla_as_found.conflicts: the Powercut tier's top power appears as 8, 12 and 20 kW across sources; the Finecut as 1–2 and 6 kW; the same 6 kW LF1530 is listed at 8.7 and 10 t and in two build years; the two listed supplies (14 kW for a 2 kW source, 12 kW for a 6 kW one) cannot both be the laser alone — the first must include the machine's drives and extraction; no cutting-thickness or cutting-speed table was found; the laser source's maker is not named ('efficiency above 30 %' is KIMLA's only figure). None of it is a welding specification.
